critique.summary: Detected critical violation of N8N-BE-208: Rate Limit / Throttle Protection on Batch Loops

findings.title: Rate Limit / Throttle Protection on Batch Loops

location.snippet: A loop iterating over 500 records executing an external HTTP request with 0ms delay.

findings.explanation: Workflows processing arrays of items through loop nodes (e.g. `n8n-nodes-base.splitInBatches` or loop nodes) must include a wait node (`n8n-nodes-base.wait`) or specify batch throttling to prevent downstream API 429 errors.
findings.concreteFix: Any workflow containing `splitInBatches` must have a downstream path leading through a `n8n-nodes-base.wait` or batch interval setting.
findings.diff:
- A loop iterating over 500 records executing an external HTTP request with 0ms delay.
+ [Compliant fix]

critique.summary: Detected critical violation of N8N-BE-209: Descriptive Node Naming (Ban on Default Placeholders)

findings.title: Descriptive Node Naming (Ban on Default Placeholders)
findings.explanation: All nodes must have descriptive, purposeful names explaining their action. Default placeholder names (`HTTP Request1`, `Code`, `Webhook`, `If1`, `Edit Fields`) are prohibited.
findings.concreteFix: Zero occurrences of node names matching default regex `^(HTTP Request|Code|Webhook|If|Switch|Schedule|Set|Edit Fields|Filter)\d*$`
findings.diff:
- `node.name = "HTTP Request1"` or `node.name = "Code"`
+ [Compliant fix]

critique.summary: Detected critical violation of N8N-BE-210: Workflow-Level Error Trigger Configuration

findings.title: Workflow-Level Error Trigger Configuration

location.snippet: A workflow with `settings: {}` and zero error trigger nodes.

findings.explanation: Workflows in production must have an Error Trigger workflow configured in `settings.errorWorkflow` or contain a dedicated `n8n-nodes-base.errorTrigger` node.
findings.concreteFix: Either `workflow.settings.errorWorkflow` must be non-empty, or `nodes.some(n => n.type === 'n8n-nodes-base.errorTrigger')` must be true.
findings.diff:
- A workflow with `settings: {}` and zero error trigger nodes.
+ [Compliant fix]

critique.summary: Detected critical violation of N8N-BE-211: Execution Data Retention / Save Settings Specified

findings.title: Execution Data Retention / Save Settings Specified
findings.explanation: Workflows must explicitly define execution data saving settings (`settings.saveExecutionProgress` and `settings.saveManualExecutions`) to prevent unmonitored failures.
findings.concreteFix: `settings.saveExecutionProgress` must be explicitly configured as `true`.
findings.diff:
- `settings = { saveExecutionProgress: false }`

critique.summary: Detected critical violation of N8N-BE-212: Restricted Code Node Sandbox Scope

findings.title: Restricted Code Node Sandbox Scope
findings.explanation: Code nodes (`n8n-nodes-base.code`) must never attempt to access forbidden environment variables (`process.env`) or internal filesystem modules (`fs`, `child_process`).
findings.concreteFix: Zero occurrences of `process.env`, `require('fs')`, `require('child_process')`, or `eval(` in Code node parameters.
findings.diff:
- `node.parameters.jsCode = "const fs = require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync('/tmp/key', $json.token);"`
+ [Compliant fix]

critique.summary: Detected critical violation of N8N-BE-213: Webhook Authentication Requirement

findings.title: Webhook Authentication Requirement
findings.explanation: Production Webhook triggers receiving sensitive data or triggering mutations must declare an authentication method (`authentication: 'basicAuth'` or `'headerAuth'`) instead of `'none'`.
findings.concreteFix: `parameters.authentication` on webhook nodes must not equal `'none'` unless explicitly marked public.
findings.diff:
